chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from ʿAmr ibn ʿUthmān, from a number of our companions, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

He was asked about a man who obtained a slave-girl from the fayʾ and had intercourse with her before it was divided. He said: “The slave-girl is to be appraised and given to him for her value, and from that there is deducted for him the share of it from the fayʾ that belongs to him; and he is to be flogged with the hadd, while the hadd is reduced from him in proportion to the amount he had a share in her.”

I said: Then how did it become that the slave-girl is given to him, he specifically, for her value rather than someone else? He said: “Because he had intercourse with her, and it cannot be ruled out that there may be a pregnancy there.”

key_terms.الْفَيْءِ: property acquired for the Muslim polity and subject to distribution
key_terms.تُقَوَّمُ: she is appraised and assigned a monetary value

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man has intercourse with a slave-girl from the fayʾ before it is divided?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a man who had intercourse with a slave-girl from the fayʾ before the distribution was completed. It explains that her value is assessed, his rightful share is deducted from that value, and a hadd punishment is applied in proportion to his liability, while assigning her to him because of the possibility of pregnancy.
